title: Intracardiac Perfusion with Fixative for Anatomical Studies
author: Janet R Keast
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.w3ffgjn
materials: Make up the following solutions: Perfusion prewash solution: To 300 ml 0.9% sodium chloride (w/v) add 3.75 ml 1% sodium nitrite (w/v) and 0.11 ml heparin (5000 IU/ml). This is made up immediately prior to use. Perfusion fixative: 4% paraformaldehyde in 0.1M phosphate buffer, pH 7.4. This is made up no longer than 48h prior to use, stored at 4C and brought to room temperature on the day of perfusion.

steps.title: Induce anesthesia
steps.instruction: Inject ketamine at 100 mg/kg and xylazine at 10 mg/kg intraperitoneally.

steps.title: Inject heart with anticoagulant
steps.instruction: After opening the chest cavity, inject the left ventricle with 0.25 mL heparin (5000 IU/mL) mixed with 0.5 mL 1 % sodium nitrite.

steps.title: Set up perfusion apparatus
steps.instruction: Connect a needle to tubing (T‑connector to pre‑wash and perfusion solutions) and attach a peristaltic pump set to 50 mL/min; insert the needle into the left ventricle, clamp it with hemostats, and make a small incision in the right atrium to allow drainage of blood and perfusate.

steps.title: Pre‑wash perfusion
steps.instruction: Perfuse with pre‑wash solution until fluid exiting the right atrium is clear, the liver and extremities appear pale (typically 2–3 min).

steps.title: Fixative perfusion
steps.instruction: Perfuse with fixative for at least 10 minutes, until organs stiffen and neural tissues are well preserved.

steps.title: Post‑fix tissue samples
steps.instruction: Dissect the required tissues and place them in fixative for an additional 1 hour at 4 °C.

steps.title: PBS washes
steps.instruction: Wash the tissues in phosphate‑buffered saline (PBS; 0.1 M, pH 7.2) three times, each wash lasting 30 minutes.

steps.title: Store tissues
steps.instruction: Store tissues in PBS containing 0.1 % sodium azide at 4 °C until use for immunohistochemistry or other microscopic analysis.
